messages.content: What is the dominant genetic trait of a Lion?

function.name: genetics_get_variant_frequency
function.description: Retrieve the frequency of a gene variant in a specific population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
In domestic cats and many wild felids—including lions—the **black‑fur allele (B)** is dominant over the white‑fur allele (b).  
Because most lions have dark coats, the B allele is considered the “dominant” form in this species. White lions, which carry two copies of the recessive b allele (bb), are rare and result from a mutation that is recessive to the normal black coat.

Or the dominant allele for black fur vs white? White lions are recessive. So black fur is dominant. Also male lions have mane due to testosterone. But that's hormonal.
